description: NaMgNiO₆I is Ilmenite-derived structured and crystallizes in the trigonal P312 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.57 Å. Mg is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share edges with three equivalent NiO₆ octahedra and edges with three equivalent IO₆ octahedra. All Mg-O bond lengths are 2.08 Å. Ni is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share edges with three equivalent MgO₆ octahedra and edges with three equivalent IO₆ octahedra. All Ni-O bond lengths are 2.10 Å. O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Mg, one Ni, and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.92 Å. I is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form IO₆ octahedra that share edges with three equivalent MgO₆ octahedra and edges with three equivalent NiO₆ octahedra.
